agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING
OF THE
CITY COUNCIL AND
REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
WEDNESDAY - JUNE 8, 2005 - CITY HALL -
7:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
A G E N D A
Public input will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered.
1.
Call to Order
2.
Invocation
3.
Pledge of Allegiance
4.
Roll Call
5.
Presentations
6.
Public Comments and Suggestions
Consent Calendar
7.
Registers of Demands dated 6/8/2005
8.
Minutes of 5/26/2005, 05/31/2005 and 6/2/2005
9.
Public Hearings
9A.
Joint public hearing of the Cerritos City Council and the Cerritos Redevelopment Agency concerning the proposed adoption of resolutions approving the use of Agency funds for payment of the cost of the installation and construction of publicly owned improvements for the Magnolia Power Plant. (To be continued to the June 23, 2005 City Council/Redevelopment Agency meeting)
9B.
A public hearing to adopt the Five-Year Implementation Plan for 2005-05 through 2008-09 for the Los Cerritos and Los Coyotes Redevelopment Project Areas pursuant to the requirements of Assembly Bill 1290 and California Health and Safety Code Section 33490. (To be continued to the June 23, 2005 Redevelopment Agency meeting)
10.
Pending Legal Matters/Resolutions for consideration
10A.
A resolution of the City Council of the City of Cerritos, California, approving participation in the Los Angeles Urban County Community Development Block Grant Program by entering into a cooperation agreement with the County of Los Angeles, for time period of July 1, 2006 through June 30, 2009
10B.
A resolution of the City Council of the City of Cerritos authorizing participation in the appeal of the Superior Court decision in the Los Angeles County Municipal stormwater permit litigation
11.
Public Works Activities
11A.
Review and consideration of a site evaluation and proposed traffic control enhancements for the intersection of Shoemaker Avenue at 195th Street
11B.
Consideration of award of contract for the construction of street improvements in 166th Street from Carmenita Road to Edwards Road, Bid No. 1000-05, Project No. 13022
12.
New and Old Business
12A.
Approval of a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with the Los Angeles County Metropolitan Transportation Authority for collecting and reporting data for the National Transit Database for Report Year 2003 and for subsequent and future report years
13.
Report on Pending Legislation
14.
City Council Communications/Committee Reports
15.
Adjournment
Recess
Reconvene
